data.content: Implementation review: APPROVED. Diff (commit 4867595e) matches spec exactly: post-write enrichment degraded to stderr warning (state_ops/state_fail_ops/alias), lease-release scan skips unresolvable profiles instead of aborting, execute_next downgrades release failures after committed writes, bound-lease error names the id. 8 regression tests; key test verified to FAIL against pre-fix code.
